title: contact.rs ChatContactSet/update ignores login changes
description: kith-chat/src/contact.rs process_update(): the update patch can contain arbitrary keys; the handler reads displayName and blocked from the patch but re-upserts with `existing.login` unconditionally, without checking whether the patch includes a `login` field. If a caller sends a patch with a new login value, the value is silently dropped rather than rejected. The spec comment says 'Re-upsert with updated values', implying login should be immutable on update, but there is no validation that rejects a caller who attempts to set it — the field is silently ignored. Consequence: ambiguous API contract; an owner who sends a login patch gets silent no-op with no error, which violates RFC 8620 §5.3 (unknown properties should be signalled as invalidArguments, not silently dropped).
